biotools.summary: AssayInspector is a model-agnostic package that facilitates data consistency assessment (DCA) by leveraging statistics, visualizations, and diagnostic summaries to identify outliers and discrepancies in datasets. It is designed to improve predictive accuracy in machine learning models, particularly in preclinical safety modeling and federated learning scenarios.
